name: Hinata
source:
Likes: Food the Protagonist makes (Especially Meat dishes)
Hobby: Walks, Sun Bathing

A dog youkai.
He's lived with the protagonist since she was young and treasures her greatly. He's always at her side.
He's easily angered and rarely smiles.
